def dense(seed):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    nf, slots = 8, 2
    fields=[{'name':'f%d'%i,'type':['time','size','count','id','flag'][i%5],'domain':[0,1]} for i in range(nf)]
    preds=[]
    for c in range(16):
        f=fields[c%nf]['name']; s=c//nf; t=fields[c%nf]['type']
        preds.append({'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[s,f]},'op':'eq','right':{'const':0,'type':t}})
        preds.append({'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[s,f]},'op':'eq','right':{'const':1,'type':t}})
    rows=[]
    for a in range(16):
        for b in range(a+1,16):
            r=[1 if c in (a,b) else 0 for c in range(16)]
            rows.append([r[i*nf:(i+1)*nf] for i in range(slots)])
    queries=[{'fixed':[],'target':[rng.randrange(slots), rng.choice(fields)['name']],'prefix':p}
             for p in ('','0','1','10','01','11') for _ in range(7)]
    return {'fields':fields,'slots':slots,'predicates':preds,'width':4,'train':rows*83,
            'approved':[[2*c,2*c+1] for c in range(16)],'queries':queries}
